content.title: In-Store Rewards | Fuel Rewards program
content.text: View offers in the Fuel Rewards® mobile app. Shop for those products inside at Shell. At checkout, enter your Alt ID or swipe your Fuel Rewards® card or linked payment card. Redeem your rewards at any participating Shell station using your Fuel Rewards® card, a linked payment card or Alt ID. Some locations offer more than what’s listed above. View all offers for any location in the Fuel Rewards® App. Buying gift cards at Shell is a great way to earn rewards while spending with your favorite brands. *Only specially marked offers are eligible for Platinum Status double rewards. Check offer Terms and Conditions to view offer eligibility. Fuel Rewards® members: Earn 10¢/gal reward when you buy (3) Chips Ahoy (1.55oz–4.1oz) product(s). Members can earn up to 2 rewards per transaction / max of 3 per day. Offer valid with Alt ID or Fuel Rewards® card or a linked payment card while supplies last. Available for qualifying products which may vary by location. Offer may be extended or discontinued at any time. Other restrictions or limitations may apply. Fuel savings expire at the end of the month following the month in which they're earned. Limit 20 gallons per redemption. Members with Platinum Status will earn 2x rewards. Restrictions apply. Unless otherwise specified in the applicable offer terms, Fuel Rewards® savings are limited to 20 gallons of fuel per purchase per vehicle or fraud limits placed by Shell and/or limits placed on your payment card by your financial institution, each of which may be lower. Dispenser may require a price of up to $0.109/gallon. Once you begin to dispense fuel using your Fuel Rewards® savings, you must dispense to the applicable offer's gallon limit or you forfeit any remaining discounted gallons of fuel. If rewards from multiple offers are combined in a redemption, the lowest gallon limit for such offers will apply. If you have a rewards balance greater than the current per-gallon price of fuel, the price will roll down to the maximum capability of the fuel equipment, and your remaining rewards will be saved for a future fuel purchase. For purchases of $75 or more, please go inside to pay. Unbranded diesel and alternative fuels may not be eligible. To learn more, visit fuelrewards.com/status or call (888) 603-0473.
